description: Frozen vectors for the ATL-specific parts of leaf construction: JCS canonicalization of entry metadata, metadata_hash, and the composite leaf hash. No RFC publishes these; each value is derived by hand from the named specification clause using an independent SHA-256 (CPython hashlib) and an independent JCS implementation -- never atl-core.

origins.atl-spec-derived: Derived by hand from atl-protocol-ietf.md, section 'Merkle Tree Structure' > 'Leaf Hash Calculation' and section 'Verification Algorithm' > 'Reconstruct Leaf Hash', using an independent SHA-256 and an independent RFC 8785 canonicalizer. Each entry carries the exact byte string that was hashed, so the value can be checked by reading and re-hashing, without running atl-core.
origins.rfc8785-derived: The canonical form was produced by an independent implementation of the RFC 8785 rules (Section 3.2.2.2 string escaping, Section 3.2.3 UTF-16 code-unit key order). All metadata here uses integers only, so the ES6 floating-point number algorithm of RFC 8785 Section 3.2.2.3 is deliberately not exercised -- see test_data/vectors/jcs/cases.json, which does exercise it and records a divergence.

metadata_hash.source: atl-protocol-ietf.md, 'Merkle Tree Structure' > 'Leaf Hash Calculation'; 'Verification Algorithm' > 'Reconstruct Leaf Hash' steps 2-4; RFC 8785

leaf_hash.note: This is RFC 6962's leaf rule (SHA256(0x00 || d), RFC 6962 Section 2.1) applied to the 64-byte record d = PayloadHash || MetadataHash. An ATL Data Tree is therefore an ordinary RFC 6962 tree over 64-byte records, which is why the vectors in test_data/vectors/merkle/trees.json transfer to it unchanged.

cases.name: boundary_all_zero
cases.note: No payload or metadata preimage; exercises the composition formula and its argument order only. `boundary_asymmetric` differs from a hypothetical swapped-argument implementation and so pins the order down.

genesis_chain_leaf_moved_out: The genesis chain leaf (compute_genesis_leaf_hash / "ATL-CHAIN-v1") used to be recorded here. It was moved to test_data/implementation_only/genesis_chain_leaf.json, outside test_data/vectors/ entirely, because the construction has no first source in atl-protocol-ietf.md: an independent SHA-256 can confirm its arithmetic but nothing can confirm its contract, so it cannot serve as a conformance reference the way every value in this file can.
